policy: Official capability first; optional personal behavior in plugins; mandatory distribution and protection in narrow host adapters.

patches.verify: Independent identity and data; account-free entry; no external update dependency; packaged offline dependencies
patches.retireWhen: Official distribution configuration offers equivalent startup and release controls

patches.verify: CAS/ACK, immutable route and credential leases, retries, revocation, request-local payload hook
patches.retireWhen: Official APIs provide equivalent managed connection semantics and payload hooks

patches.verify: Native identity, pre-model admission, command admission, cancellation, restore, fail closed
patches.retireWhen: An official mandatory protection owner meets the same acceptance suite

patches.verify: Official shell and composer, stale preview refusal, draft attachments, artifact identity, task projection
Real Loader activation, default off, consent, bounded requests, redaction, independent feature disposal and full unload
patches.retireWhen: Official capability meets the personal use case without extra model or data effects

patches.verify: Three isolated transparent windows, narrow IPC, sender identity, resource decode, position, pin/navigation, shutdown
patches.retireWhen: Official native extension API can own equivalent transparent windows

patches.verify: Derived app launch name and data home; no claim of arbitrary CLI profile protection parity
patches.retireWhen: Official CLI distribution metadata controls app identity and data home

patches.verify: Generate from source; doc-sync identifies event/config contract drift
patches.retireWhen: Private package catalog discovery becomes automatic upstream
